selection.selection_rule: Recorded RL base architecture; higher exported development score between its SFT and RL checkpoints that pass the completed 8K audit; SFT on ties
selection.streaming_scope: Exact token-ID incremental input validated by the 8K audit; arbitrary text rollback is implemented and awaits the separate final L20 audit
